key_highlights: ASX slides as oil nears US$100/barrel amid Iran conflict, fuelling RBA rate-hike bets; big four banks (CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX) fall
RBA signals recessionary stance; Australian business conditions weakest since pandemic, home buyer sentiment collapses
Iron ore under severe pressure – 'drowning, not waving' – weighing on BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX
Austal (ASX: JAU) jumps on US$1.9b acquisition bid; gold miners (Auric, Golden Dragon, Gateway, Forrestania) see strong WA pipeline activity
China's crude buying rebounds 29% but patience with Trump erodes; geopolitical risk premium elevated
Bathla collapse ripples through private credit market, raising systemic liquidity concerns
Power giant seeks AI data centre build at coal sites; NSW faces potential power shortage – energy transition tension

sectors.trend: Iron ore in severe downturn; copper (Flagship) and gold (Auric, Golden Dragon, Gateway, Forrestania) see strong exploration/M&A activity. Commodity mix shifting from iron ore to precious metals and base metals.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face margin pressure from weak iron ore. Gold miners benefit from safe-haven flows amid geopolitical risk. Copper upside supports diversified miners.

sectors.trend: Big four banks fall as rising oil fuels rate-hike expectations, compressing net interest margin outlook. Bathla private credit collapse raises credit-risk concerns. Qantas $35M payout signals corporate stress.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX under pressure from rate uncertainty and credit cycle deterioration. Private credit exposure a new risk vector.

sectors.trend: Oil near US$100 on Iran conflict; missiles targeting oil infrastructure. Power giant pursuing AI data centres at coal sites. NSW power shortage risk. Data centres straining energy transition.
sectors.implications: Woodside (WDS.AX), Santos (STO.AX) benefit from oil spike. Coal-to-data-centre pivot creates regulatory and ESG tension. Energy demand structural shift.

sectors.trend: Home buyer sentiment collapses; high-end property sees steepest falls while affordable segment resilient. Business conditions weakest since pandemic. BYD targets 2.5M exports.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, SPG.AX) and homebuilders (DHG.AX, MVP.AX) face demand headwinds. Consumer staples (WES.AX, WOW.AX) relatively defensive. EV transition accelerates.

sectors.trend: CSL.AX stable as defensive. AI data centre build-out creates infrastructure demand. ATO vs Big Tech tax battle signals regulatory risk for tech.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, SGH.AX offer defensive exposure. Data centre infrastructure (VIX.AX, IAG.AX) benefits from AI capex. Tech faces tax headwinds.

key_themes: Geopolitical oil shock (Iran) driving rate-hike fears and equity risk-off
Iron ore structural weakness vs gold/copper rotation in mining
RBA recessionary pivot – policy dilemma between inflation and growth
Energy transition vs AI data centre demand tension
China-US decoupling accelerating; commodity demand bifurcation
Housing market bifurcation: luxury weakness, affordable resilience

risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge energy exposure; favour gold and defensive equities; monitor Brent crude and AUD/USD
Reduce rate-sensitive REIT and property exposure; favour fixed income and dividend payers
Underweight BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX; rotate to gold and copper names
Review bank credit exposure to private credit; favour large-cap listed financials
Avoid high-end property REITs; monitor ABS housing data weekly

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Yen carry trade unwind / global liquidity
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce leveraged positions; monitor JGB yields and AUD/JPY

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold miners on safe-haven and WA pipeline momentum
opportunities.rationale: Geopolitical risk, oil shock, and RBA uncertainty drive gold demand; multiple WA projects (Auric, Golden Dragon, Gateway, Forrestania) in advanced stages

opportunities.recommendation: Add Austal (JAU.AX) on US$1.9b bid catalyst
opportunities.rationale: M&A premium provides near-term upside; defence/shipbuilding sector benefits from global rearmament

opportunities.recommendation: Favour copper-exposed miners on structural demand
opportunities.rationale: Flagship increasing Canadian copper stakes; copper benefits from electrification and AI data centre build-out

opportunities.recommendation: Defensive tilt to CSL.AX and consumer staples
opportunities.rationale: Recession risk and rate uncertainty favour low-beta, dividend-paying healthcare and staples

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce or hedge iron ore exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore in structural downturn; China demand weakening; 'drowning not waving' signals prolonged weakness

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim rate-sensitive REITs and high-end property
defensive_moves.rationale: RBA tightening + collapsing buyer sentiment + NZ crash spillover risk

defensive_moves.recommendation: Monitor private credit exposure in bank holdings
defensive_moves.rationale: Bathla collapse signals broader private credit stress; potential write-downs at CBA, NAB, ANZ, WBC

defensive_moves.recommendation: Maintain AUD/USD hedge given oil-driven AUD pressure
defensive_moves.rationale: Oil spike is mixed for AUD (commodity exporter positive, but import cost inflation negative); yen carry unwind adds volatility

market_outlook.short_term: ASX 200 (^AXJO) likely to remain under pressure over 1–3 months. Oil near US$100, RBA recessionary pivot, and iron ore weakness dominate. Gold miners and defensives outperform. Expect volatility around RBA meetings and Iran developments. Sentiment score 32/100 – risk-off regime.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautiously constructive if oil stabilises and RBA pivots. Gold and copper structural demand supports mining rotation. Housing bifurcation continues. AI data centre capex creates new infrastructure demand. Key risk: prolonged China slowdown or further geopolitical escalation.
